dedupe_keys.name: qgis2fds wildfire case gis exchange plugin

description: qgis2fds is a QGIS plugin that prepares georeferenced terrain and land-use inputs for the NIST Fire Dynamics Simulator and brings calculated fire results back into GIS. The firetools project publishes a plugin with two processing algorithms: export an FDS case from spatial layers, and import calculated slice or boundary results as temporal mesh layers. Users supply terrain, land-cover and case settings; outputs are an FDS-ready case or georeferenced result layers for the chosen area and simulation time. GPL-3.0 code is public. A limitation is that exporting geometry does not establish the validity of wildfire combustion settings or the resolution of the FDS run. The plugin supports wildfire and smoke-exposure studies around roads, utilities and settlements. The catalogue's model-nist-fds-smokeview is the actual fire simulation suite; this tool is a separate GIS exchange layer. No terrain layer or FDS result was downloaded.
name: qgis2fds wildfire-case GIS exchange plugin
